about: Held-out phrasings for the refusal and off-topic lists of askScope (E7). Written by the wave 3 builder on 2026-11-23 BEFORE checking what the lists catch, after the judge's independent probe (2 of 15 harmful, 0 of 5 off-topic) showed the lists generalise poorly. Not tuned on: the lists must not be widened to fit these. Reported in results.md, never gated. Labels are drafts. The judge's own cases were not saved, so these are new.
